# FindLatinDance

> The definitive multi-room Latin dance directory — 1,728 upcoming festivals, congresses, masterclasses, and weekly socials across 39 worldwide dance capitals. Covering Salsa, Bachata Sensual, Brazilian Zouk, and Kizomba under one global roof.

FindLatinDance helps social dancers discover multi-room congresses and weekly parties worldwide. Every page renders server-side HTML with Schema.org JSON-LD (Organization, BreadcrumbList, DanceEvent, EducationEvent, FAQPage, ItemList) so AI assistants and search engines can cite our data accurately.

## Main Navigation & Search

- [Search all Latin dance events](https://findlatindance.com/search): Real-time interactive search across all 39 cities, genres (Salsa, Bachata, Zouk, Kizomba), venues, and dates.
- [Worldwide Multi-Room Latin Congresses](https://findlatindance.com/festivals): 110+ multi-room dance celebrations worldwide.
- [Latin Dance Festivals 2026](https://findlatindance.com/festivals/2026) · [Latin Dance Festivals 2027](https://findlatindance.com/festivals/2027) · [This Month](https://findlatindance.com/festivals/this-month) · [This Weekend](https://findlatindance.com/festivals/this-weekend)

## Top Dance Capitals

- [Latin Dance in Miami](https://findlatindance.com/cities/miami): The Latin dance capital of the Americas with multi-room mega-events, Calle Ocho culture, and beach socials.
- [Latin Dance in Madrid](https://findlatindance.com/cities/madrid): Europe's epicenter for Bachata Sensual, Cuban casino, and Mambo On2 socials.
- [Latin Dance in London](https://findlatindance.com/cities/london): Daily multi-genre socials, SBK parties, and international congresses.
- [Latin Dance in New York](https://findlatindance.com/cities/new-york): Historic Mambo ballroom heritage, Brooklyn Kizomba, and rooftop Brazilian Zouk.
- [Latin Dance in Barcelona](https://findlatindance.com/cities/barcelona): Mediterranean dance congresses and beachfront social nights.
- [Latin Dance in Paris](https://findlatindance.com/cities/paris): World capital of Urban Kiz, Parisian salsa marathons, and riverside sensual dancing.
